'''R3-T6''' was an [[R3-series astromech droid]] that served the [[Galactic Empire]] and had astronavigational duties on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first Death Star]].<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> During the [[Battle of Yavin]], the [[astromech droid]] was on board the [[Death Star]] when the [[battle station]] was attacked by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ANH" />

During the battle, the [[droid]] rolled down one of the [[Space station|station's]] corridors and passed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] before he gave the order to launch [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] to combat the rebels. The station was destroyed by the Alliance soon after.<ref name="ANH" /> R3-T6 had a white chassis with a [[Color|red]] trim and a clear dome. As an R3 unit, it was part of [[Industrial Automaton]]'s [[R-series]] of astromech droids<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> and stood 1.09 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="Height" />

==Behind the scenes==
R3-T6 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The droid's scene was filmed on Stage 2 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[June 17]] and [[June 28]], [[1976]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars]]''</ref>

In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the droid was first identified in the [[2016]] reference book written by [[Michael Kogge]] included in the ''[[Star Wars: R2-D2 Deluxe Book and Model Set]]''.<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on an [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/ANewHope-Dark/large/r3t6.gif "R3-T6 (Arthree-Teesix)" card] in the ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], which was released by [[Decipher]] in [[1996]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=R3-T6 (Arthree-Teesix)}}</ref>
